text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: Budget 1 false alarm per flight-hour, recalibrated per protocol. Unseen mission: leave one of the three missions out of training and test on it (pooled). Unseen attack type: leave one attack family out. Learned

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: models: mean of 5 seeds. False alarms per protocol: R10_false_alarms. Missing points: not run for that detector (the autoencoder never sees attacks, so it has no unseen-attack-type run).
